newsitem.title: UK: IPE declines comment on AIC gas oil charges.
newsitem.headline: IPE declines comment on AIC gas oil charges.

text.p: The International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) said on Monday it was following procedures on the November gas oil contract and declined to comment on a statement by AIC that Cargill had failed to take delivery of 160,000-190,000 tonnes.
"We are following our procedures," an IPE spokesman said.
"It would be wrong of me to comment on allegations made to the press without these having been substantiated by documented evidence."

He was replying by telephone to a request for comment on an AIC statement on Monday that Cargill had failed to lift between 160,000 and 190,000 tonnes of gas oil during the November 15-30 IPE delivery.

An AIC spokesman said earlier he planned to sell the product into the ARA barge market in order to mitigate what he called his company's damage arising out of the contract, adding the matter was now in the hands of the IPE.
Cargill has denied AIC allegations that it has failed to perform on the contract in line with IPE rules.
